subject: Request: transaction-level tax tagging + VAT/GST evidence for Q3 APAC invoices
messages:
From: Sanjay Tan <sanjay.tan@heliologistics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Helio Logistics Billing <accounts@heliologistics.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T01:12:00+08:00
Subject: Transaction-level tax tagging request and VAT/GST evidence for Q3 invoices

Hi Mina / Marcus,

Thanks for the earlier call — quick follow-up from our finance team. We need transaction-level tax tags (country, tax type, tax rate, reverse-charge flag, and withholding flag) for all Redwood invoices issued to Helio Logistics in Q3 (Jul–Sep 2026). Our APAC treasury requires line-item detail to map withheld amounts across our entities.

Attached are two sample invoices where the amounts are in question: invoice_9876.pdf (Singapore-incurred services) and a summary sheet with the booking list. Please also provide the VAT/GST registration numbers you relied on for tax treatment verification and any evidence (certs, self-attestations, or signed PO language) that supports reverse-charge or non-resident supply treatment.

Can you confirm by EOB SG time (today) whether Redwood can produce a transaction-level CSV or XLSX + a short cover note explaining any withheld amounts we should expect on our end? If there are gaps, flag which invoices will require amended invoices or credit notes.

Thanks,
Sanjay Tan
Head of Finance Ops — Helio Logistics
Sanjay.tan@heliologistics.com
Attachment: invoice_9876.pdf (PDF), booking_summary_Q3.csv (CSV)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Tan <sanjay.tan@heliologistics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T02:05:00+08:00
Subject: Re: Transaction-level tax tagging request and VAT/GST evidence for Q3 invoices

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Vanessa from Billing and Rishi from Tax Ops so we can produce the transaction-level file and evidence pack. Quick clarifying items before we generate the exports:

1) Scope: you asked for "all Redwood invoices issued to Helio Logistics in Q3" — do you want only invoices billed to the Singapore legal entity (Helio Logistics Pte Ltd), or also invoices to the AU and IN entities where a different billing/ship-to was used?

2) Output format: we can provide a CSV with columns (invoice_id, invoice_line_id, invoice_date, currency, gross_amount, taxable_amount, tax_rate, tax_amount, tax_type, tax_jurisdiction, reverse_charge_flag, withholding_flag, tax_id_used). Is that acceptable?

3) Evidence: we can include copies of the customer-supplied VAT/GST numbers, validation screenshots (where applicable), and our internal tax memo for any reverse-charge decisions. If you need signed attestations from Helio, let us know and we can route via DocuSign.

We expect to have the CSV + evidence file back to you within 6 hours for Singapore-only invoices; full APAC scope (SG + AU + IN) will take ~24 hours because Rishi needs to reconcile withholding entries for IN and GST registration confirmations for AU.

Action: please confirm scope (SG only vs all APAC entities) and we’ll proceed.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Manager, Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Sanjay Tan <sanjay.tan@heliologistics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T05:30:00+08:00
Subject: Re: Transaction-level tax tagging request and VAT/GST evidence for Q3 invoices

Hi team / Sanjay — attaching the export and supporting evidence pack. See attached: tax_evidence_Q3_APAC.xlsx (row-level mapping) and invoice_9876.pdf (original). Highlights:

- Scope: we exported all invoices billed to Helio Logistics Pte Ltd (SG) and Helio Logistics Pty Ltd (AU) with invoice_date between 2026-07-01 and 2026-09-30.
- Format: the spreadsheet contains a "tax_flag" column with values: "standard_gst", "reverse_charge", "withholding_applied" and a "tax_id_used" column populated where we had a validated customer tax id.
- Singapore (SG): for invoice_9876 we applied non-resident service treatment at source — the customer provided UEN: 2023-XL-9 and we validated via screenshots (sheet tab: SG_validation). We did not charge SG GST on that line because the service was treated as supplied to a business with reverse-charge obligations in SG. Please confirm your local accounting team will record the reverse-charge liability.
- Australia (AU): a handful of AU bookings had GST charged; where Helio supplied an ABN we zero-rated supply where appropriate. If you see any inbound invoice with "withholding_applied" we applied an APAC withholding code for local tax withholdings per your country-specific instructions.
- India (IN): we flagged potential tax withholding on a subset of lines that reference services consumed in India. Rishi is reconciling the exact withheld amounts and will comment separately.

Attached files: tax_evidence_Q3_APAC.xlsx (XLSX, row-level mapping), invoice_9876.pdf (PDF).

If Helio needs a formal cover letter from Redwood explaining the reverse-charge rationale per jurisdiction, we can generate that — let us know which invoices to prioritise for formal letters.

Vanessa Ortiz
Billing Manager — Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Attachments: tax_evidence_Q3_APAC.xlsx, invoice_9876.pdf

From: Sanjay Tan <sanjay.tan@heliologistics.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Helio Logistics Billing <accounts@heliologistics.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T08:45:00+08:00
Subject: Re: Transaction-level tax tagging request and VAT/GST evidence for Q3 invoices

Thanks Vanessa — received and this looks good. A couple of follow-ups after a quick internal review:

- For invoice_9876 we will record the reverse-charge in our AP reconciliation but need a one-line cover letter that states Redwood's position (service supplied to Helio Logistics Pte Ltd, no SG GST charged, customer UEN provided and validated). Can you produce that by EOD?
- For the AU lines flagged with "withholding_applied", can Rishi confirm the statutory withheld percentage you used and the ledger account mapping so our ERP posts match?
- We will need an amended invoice for one line where the billed currency was misstated (USD vs SGD) — I’ve attached a short note to accounts@heliologistics.com. If you can draft the credit note + reissue flow that would help speed reconciliation.

If you prefer, we can route the formal sign-off through our AP contact (accounts@heliologistics.com) once the cover letter and the AU withholding confirmation are in place.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Sanjay
Sanjay Tan
Head of Finance Ops — Helio Logistics
